outlooks.confidence: Tested on forecasts made 3 days ahead, on days from 17 Jul to 17 Oct: 30% of the days this model flagged did cross the line (2% would by chance), and it flagged 28% of the days that crossed it.
outlooks.details: Our own forecast, made before the period it covers. Forecast rain, scaled by 1.94 to match the 30-year record, reaches this place's 99th percentile for the month. The topsoil was wetter than 50% of the same month in 1996-2025 when last measured (14 Oct). 18 Oct: 84.7 mm (95.2 mm over three days) against a usual worst of 38.39 mm in a day and 79.02 mm over three days. 19 Oct: 1 mm (96.2 mm over three days) against a usual worst of 38.39 mm in a day and 79.02 mm over three days. 20 Oct: 2.1 mm (87.8 mm over three days) against a usual worst of 38.39 mm in a day and 79.02 mm over three days.
outlooks.evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-10-17, compared with NASA POWER daily records for Miami, Florida, United States, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
outlooks.verificationRule: Checked against the rainfall NASA POWER records for these days once they are available: correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not.

outlooks.title: Extreme heat forecast for Lima, 18 Oct to 24 Oct
outlooks.issuedAtBasis: Timestamp of the numerical weather prediction model run, issued before the target window.
outlooks.confidence: Tested on forecasts made 3 days ahead, on days from 17 Jul to 17 Oct: 45% of the days this model flagged did cross the line (11% would by chance), and it flagged 59% of the days that crossed it.
outlooks.details: Our own forecast, made before the period it covers. Forecast daily highs, corrected by -0.1 °C for the difference between the forecast service and the 30-year record, reach this place's 95th percentile for the time of year on 7 days in a row, and its 99th on at least one. That line is moved up 0.4 °C for the warming this place's record shows since its middle year. 18 Oct: 25.4 °C against a usual worst of 23.9 °C. 19 Oct: 25.7 °C against a usual worst of 23.9 °C. 20 Oct: 26.3 °C against a usual worst of 23.9 °C. 21 Oct: 26.3 °C against a usual worst of 23.9 °C. 22 Oct: 25.6 °C against a usual worst of 23.9 °C. 23 Oct: 24.2 °C against a usual worst of 23.9 °C. 24 Oct: 24.4 °C against a usual worst of 23.9 °C.
outlooks.evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-10-17, compared with NASA POWER daily records for Lima, Lima Province, Peru, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
outlooks.verificationRule: Checked against the daily maximum temperature NASA POWER records for these days once they are available: correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not.
